cuts.text: Monkey wants to build an automated banana factory.
Which new Anthropic model does Monkey hire?
There are two new apes in the jungle.
Option one. Hire Gorilla Fable 5.
Fable 5 is a giant Mythos gorilla!
Built for multi-day autonomous research.
Deep reasoning. Long horizon tasks.
Monkey hands Fable 5 broken banana code.
Fable 5 stares at the screen.
Thinks for five days straight!
No sleep. No banana break.
Rebuilds the entire factory from scratch!
Fable 5 gets top scores on SWE-bench!
Number one on the AI index!
Gorilla dominates every test.
Monkey happy! Monkey hires Fable 5!
Then Monkey gets the bill.
Input costs ten bananas per million words.
Output costs fifty bananas per million words.
Monkey reads the invoice three times.
Your card was declined!
Monkey wallet empty.
Pesky gorilla pricing.
Monkey poor... monkey sad...
Option two. Hire Chimp Engineer Opus 5.
Opus 5 is the flagship workhorse!
Built for daily software engineering.
Monkey hands Opus 5 one million scrolls.
Opus 5 reads everything in one second!
One million token context window!
Fixes code. Builds tools. Audits security.
Finished before lunch time.
On intelligence tests, Opus 5 ties Fable 5!
Same brain. Same gorilla-level reasoning.
But Opus 5 wears a yellow hard hat.
Shows up to work every single day.
Best of all, Opus 5 costs half!
Five bananas input per million words.
Twenty-five bananas output per million words.
Half price! Same intelligence!
Monkey wallet happy! Monkey rich!
But wait. Which model is actually better?
Monkey runs a jungle stress test.
Gives both models the exact same broken app.
Fable 5 disappears for three days.
Returns with a complex masterpiece.
Opus 5 fixes the bug in two hours.
Both apps work perfectly.
So what is the secret difference?
Fable 5 thinks deeper and takes longer.
Opus 5 thinks fast and ships code faster.
Same destination. Different jungle paths.
Option three. Secret jungle discounts.
Both models have Adaptive Thinking.
Monkey turns the brain knob up or down.
Low effort for quick simple answers.
Max effort for deep gorilla reasoning.
Monkey controls how hard they think!
Both models use pre-peeled banana caching.
Show the same scroll blueprint twice?
Monkey Bank gives ninety percent discount!
Opus 5 cached input costs half a banana.
Fable 5 cached input costs one banana.
Jungle startup runs super cheap with caching!
So which model should Monkey pick?
Multi-day autonomous research jobs?
Complex multi-step engineering projects?
Hire Gorilla Fable 5.
Worth every single banana!
Daily coding copilots and chat assistants?
Fast reliable software engineering?
Hire Chimp Engineer Opus 5!
Ninety-five percent performance at half price!
Smart Monkey uses both.
Fable 5 for big gorilla tasks.
Opus 5 for daily engineering.
Two monkeys. One jungle. Maximum bananas!
Save your bananas.
